articles.title: Trump’s potential AI czar, Jay Clayton, helped pioneer the SEC’s crypto crackdown
articles.snippet: The former SEC chairman who may be tapped to oversee the Trump administration's AI work has a potentially divisive history as a watchdog of tech innovation.

articles.title: Trump is expected to appoint Jay Clayton as new AI czar: Reports

articles.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
articles.snippet: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

articles.title: Trump Is Hosting Yet Another Meme Coin Dinner: Here Are the Details
articles.snippet: The TRUMP meme coin project is inviting its top 185 holders to a Nov. 22 gala dinner with President Trump two weeks after ethics disputes over his crypto interests helped stall the Clarity Act in the Senate.
